result.summary: Completed the career-facing people/network layer (roster B19-B22) on top of the existing Career Ops integration. LinkedIn outreach drafting (B21): linkedin_workflow.build_outreach_drafts() now emits three unsent variants (networking, recruiter, hiring_manager), each with an explicit unsent_state block (sent/sent_at/recipient_selected/connection_request_created/message_queued/scheduled all false or null, attachments_sent 0, owner_approval_required true) and a per-draft provenance block (generator, canonical cv.md/profile.yml/cv-facts.json SHA-256s, exact cv.md:<line> refs). The hiring-manager variant names the role/employer ONLY from the resolved Career Ops record (references_job) and is omitted when no job context resolves. Built the Interview Prep Agent (B22) as career-ops/interview_prep.py + interview_prep_schema.json: it consumes a canonical JobBrief (career-ops/job_intelligence.py), an optional cited research file via the briefing module's own provider interface, and the canonical cv.md/profile.yml/cv-facts.json, and produces technical prep, behavioural prep, a likely-question list, evidence-backed talking points and an explicit unknown list. Every question is a deterministic template marked employer_supplied=false with the verbatim posting line and source_line it came from; every talking point quotes a canonical CV line verbatim at a checked cv.md line; a requirement with no canonical evidence becomes owner_input_required with an explicit owner action; candidate_claims and external_actions_taken are always empty and interview_scheduled/attended are false. External posting/messaging/connecting/applying remain owner-gated (guard refuses and logs every one). A truthfulness defect was found by test and fixed: the first evidence matcher scored any term overlap, so a mainframe-RACF requirement was reported evidence_backed off the word 'security' alone; evidence_matching.general_terms now strips domain words before scoring and qualification requirements resolve to the canonical qualification headings instead. Acceptance: 27/27 checks on labelled synthetic fixtures, re-run and recorded against code SHA bc6391c.
result.owner_action_required: Optional owner decision (does not block anything, recorded as item 13 in tasks-or-issues/overnight-owner-actions-2026-09-24.md): say whether the live LinkedIn surface should ever have account access.
